title: SvgMpath
responsibility: Renders the native mpath element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgMpath.children
inputs.description: An optional Svelte Snippet used as child content inside the native mpath element. It is rendered only when children is truthy; otherwise no child content is rendered.

outputs.name: SvgMpath
outputs.description: Renders the native SVG mpath element with all remaining props spread onto it; truthy children are rendered inside it. The component adds no wrapper element.
